title: AWS Publishes aws-emulator, a Local AWS Clone Built by AI Agents
summary: AWS has published an official \`aws-emulator\` repository that lets developers run tests against local clones of many AWS services without a paid API key. The emulator is written in Rust and, according to the accompanying account, was produced by a swarm of autonomous agents that generated 29,684 commits in the project&\#x27;s first three weeks; Swami Sivasubramanian describes the effort in a guest post on Werner Vogels&\#x27; blog. On macOS and Windows it currently requires Docker, and the emulator&\#x27;s security documentation says not to use it for IAM policies and permissions boundaries, resource-based policies, KMS key policies, cross-account or cross-Region access, or other security controls.
